title: Closed collaborative workflow event payloads
description: Newly authored owner contract under DL-090 (DL-091 for collaboration.failed): CV-460 to CV-478 in Plans/Contracts_V0.md, backed by the per-family search reports/event-authority-20261104/DC-binding-search.md. One closed definition per family and scope edition, each with its own schema ID: pm.collaboration_event.<token>.v1 for project scope and pm.collaboration_event.<token>.application.v1 for application scope. The semantic owner is Plans/Collaborative_Workflows.md (CW-100 to CW-118); Storage persistence, identity and transitions are SP-460 to SP-478. Closed enumerations owned by CW section 12 are referenced from Plans/collaborative_workflows_contracts.schema.json. Nothing here admits a family: each stays quarantined before append or projection until its own Storage admission landing, one family per landing.

identifier.description: CV-460: a bounded identifier, 1 to 256 characters, no whitespace.

non_secret_ref.description: CV-460 adopts CV-353 rule 6's reference form by name: kind:value, lowercase kind, at most 256 characters, no whitespace; it names an object, grants no access and holds no credential, account identifier, local absolute path or content.

utc_timestamp.description: CV-460: RFC 3339 UTC ending in Z; calendar validity is the checker's valid_utc_datetime rule.

reconfigure_change_kind.description: CV-460: the change_kind constants of the CW section 10 / CWR-031 reconfigure_change union in Plans/collaborative_workflows_contracts.schema.json, listed by value; the checker compares the two sets.
